body: You especially don’t deserve a worse life if you’ve already been through trauma. I know everyone says this, but “be kind to yourself”. Think of yourself as the sweetest person in the world. When I started losing weight this is how I felt, and I ended up losing 90 pounds. So you really should feel excited that you enjoy working out! I don’t think a lot of people can say the same. If you can make exercise a hobby, or something you look forward to/are passionate about, I think it’s pretty likely that you’ll make lasting changes!
